title: True / False
description: Decide whether each statement is true or false.
instructions: Every question in this quiz is of one type: True / False.
Use it to test how this question type looks and is marked.

questions.question: Solid ionic compounds conduct electricity.
questions.explanation: The ions are fixed in the lattice. They conduct only when molten or dissolved.

questions.question: Light travels faster in a vacuum than in glass.
questions.explanation: Glass slows light down, which is why it refracts.

questions.question: In most programming languages, 0.1 + 0.2 is exactly equal to 0.3.
questions.explanation: Binary floating point cannot store 0.1 or 0.2 exactly, so the sum is slightly different from 0.3.

questions.question: Water boils at a lower temperature at high altitude.
questions.explanation: Lower air pressure means a lower boiling point.
